newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Row over hen claims three lives in Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Row over hen claims three lives in Bangladesh.

text.p: An angry villager shot dead his old neighbour and two others in Bangladesh's southern district of Chittagong in a feud over a hen, newspapers reported on Thursday.
They said 80-year-old Mokbul Ahmed, his son and daughter-in-law were sprayed with bullets in a fight for the hen on Wednesday.
The Daily Star said the killings took place in a remote village called Kutubkhali. It did not name Ahmed's neighbour.
The two families were said to have had long-running disputes over land and other issues.
